answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1242 Country: India Title: I want to ask you that performing Namaz in the Mosque constructed in graveyard is permitted (Jayaz) or not? Question: I want to ask you that performing Namaz in the Mosque constructed in graveyard is permitted (Jayaz) or not? Answer ID: 1242 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 439/437=M) It is permissible to perform salah in a mosque built in a graveyard: لا بأس بالصلاۃ فی المقبرۃ اذا کان فیھا موضع اعد للصلاۃ ولیس فیہ قبر (مرقاۃ شرح مشکوۃ: 2/218) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
